drawings.description: deux carrés emboîtés, en perspective, formés des suites $L_i \to E_i \to M_i$, $L_i' \to E_i' \to M_i'$, $L_i'' \to E_i'' \to M_i''$ et $L_i''' \to E_i''' \to M_i'''$, reliés par des flèches obliques et des signes d'égalité ($M_i' \Vert M_i$) ; le dessin est trop surchargé pour être mis en \texttt{tikz-cd} sans choisir des flèches
drawings.kind: arrow diagram (two nested squares in perspective)
drawings.notes: Redrawn on a tight crop: every node where it is written and every stroke where it stands. Rows as read: L_i - E_i' -> M_i' (top), L_i'' - E_i'' ... M_i, L_i''' - (down arrow) - E_i''' - || <- M_i', L_i' -> E_i' -> M_i (bottom); at the right M_i' above M_i' with a double vertical stroke between them (the transcription's M_i' || M_i). Between the rows: a small arrow from E_i' down to E_i'', a vertical stroke from E_i' with a cross bar and a down arrow below it, a stroke with a point from the struck letter above down to M_i, a heavy arrow from the right into M_i, a double stroke with an arrowhead down the left side, a small arrow with a parallel stroke from L_i''' down-left to L_i', a small arrow down-left to E_i', a stroke with a point at its end from M_i' at the right down to M_i at the bottom, a long vertical and a double vertical stroke between E_i''' and M_i'. Left out: the overwritten letter M_i' above the top arrow (struck), a small cross mark above L_i''' (drawn as a +), the prime-like strokes above the bottom E (which may make it E_i''). Still a reading: the primes of most labels (they follow the transcription's scheme where the page is unclear: the strokes over L_i'' are two slashes and a bar), which strokes are arrows.
